title: automation: New similar on a flow with a live override answers 403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE, because the copy keeps the source's overrides block
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ④ child of epic #28236, filed on the maintainer's word in direct chat with the epic PM seat, 2026-11-03: 「发记录并立卡」 and 「相关卡 p1, 让车道处理」. ⛔ Not a claim.
QA-source: #29648 · automation.package-flow-override · off-clause
Part of #28236 · governs: ADR-0146 D2, D4, D9
Reader: `domain:server` (the clone door in `packages/runtime`).
Dedupe (open and closed): `clone override`, `New similar`, `NOT_OVERRIDABLE clone`. #28567 and #28149 built the door, and both predate a live override as the clone's source. **New.**
reach: any packaged flow customized in Studio. Studio and the API both meet it.
type: Bug

**Business reason.** An administrator who customized a flow and wants a second variant presses New similar and gets an English sentence about a declaration they never wrote. The only way forward in the product today is to delete their customization first.

## What happens

Measured on `main` at `322cf9068f`, twice in Studio and once over the API.

| source state | `POST /api/v1/automation/showcase_budget_approval/clone` |
|:--|:--|
| no override | 200, status `obsolete`, `packageId com.example.showcase.custom` |
| published override | **403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE**: "'flow/showcase_budget_approval_copy' declares an override of 'com.example.showcase', which ships no flow named 'showcase_budget_approval_copy'. Remove `overrides` to keep it as 'com.example.showcase.custom''s own item, or correct the name (ADR-0146 D2)." |

The Studio dialog (`auto-new-similar-dialog`) shows that sentence and stays open. No flow is written.

## Reproduce

1. Publish an override of `showcase_budget_approval` (Customize, edit a node label, Publish).
2. `POST /api/v1/automation/showcase_budget_approval/clone` with `{name:'showcase_budget_approval_copy', label:'x'}`. Expected: a switched-off copy in the pair (ADR-0146 D4). Actual: the 403 above.
3. Restore package original, and repeat step 2: 200.

## Why (read from source, the dev confirms)

`cloneFlowDefinition` (`packages/runtime/src/flow-clone.ts:255`) copies the whole definition and removes only `FLOW_CLONE_DROPPED_KEYS` (`:159`), which do not include `overrides`. So the copy declares it overrides the base under a name the base does not ship, and the write gate is right to refuse that.

## Wanted

- The copy never carries the source's `overrides` block: it is the pair's own item, under a new name (D2, D4).
- It copies what the source serves: with a live override, the override's definition. The dev states this in the PR, and asks if the code says otherwise.
- A pin at the clone door with a live override as the source, and a clause added to `automation.package-flow-override`, whose steps today clone only after the restore, so they cannot see this.

Links back: #29648, #28567, #28149, #28236, ADR-0146 D4.
